description: X5.13: rotary triple inverted pendulum on the spatial multibond stdlib (NOT a Quanser product: the arm, the SRV02 servo and the pendulum links of the Quanser rotary double pendulum, chained short + short + medium). World -> Mount -> J1 (Revolute3D about world z, the arm) -> arm bar (RigidBody3D) -> J2, J3, J4 (Revolute3D about the arm axis, one per link), every body a RigidBody3D with a distributed mass (COM at the bar middle). The arm is driven by an SRV02-like servo with a 15 V amplifier: Motor (ElectricDrive, voltage input) -> Shaft (ElasticShaft) -> Gear (IdealGear, 70:1) -> J1.drive. The 1 kHz firmware Ctrl (phases: idle, discrete TVLQR swing-up along the collocation trajectory, latched discrete LQR balance) reads the joint angles and rates. Dist is a force pulse on the tip of the top link. Joint compliance kt = kr = 1e8 (N/m, N m/rad); every state is integral. Flexible-arm models (flex_design.py, flex_build.py, flex_finish.py): the arm as a FlexibleBeam3D, a 3 x 50 mm stainless strip on edge; -flex runs the rigid firmware (it fails: the arm's first bending mode goes unstable), -flex-lowpass the firmware with a 12 Hz low-pass in the loop (it catches), -flex-free the free swing; flex-tap and flex-free-stiff are parameter-override runs of -flex-free.

first vertical arm mode (the arm starts without its gravity sag and rings): the pendulum assembly is a rigid tip mass 0.321 kg with 0.0526 kg m^2 about the tip.
